title: 第5章 非礼勿视第6章 抱着美男睡
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑问张文说道：“到牧城需要多久？”
张文说道：“大概要二三天才能到。”
昔小苑有点苦恼的说道：“这么远呀…”
不是吧~两三天的时间哦…在她那世界做飞机就能很快到达，即使火车地铁什么的也是唰唰~的快。
张文看昔小苑这么苦恼，说道：“丞相呀…这算快的了，而且我们走近道，两三天已经算快的了。”
昔小苑点了点头，一脸苦涩的说道：“行吧。”
时间正慢慢的过去了。夜晚来临，昔小苑拉起窗帘，看天都暗下来了，便对张文说道：“在这附近找个客栈吧，大伙们赶了一天的路了，该歇歇脚了。”
张文点了点头，而后走出马车，不久就回来说道：“丞相，已经找到一家客栈了，我们过去吧。”
昔小苑：“行。”
大部队在一家客栈住下，客栈的房间大部分都被他们包下了。反正钱也是从穆贺的口袋掏……
所以咱不怕，咱有钱，而且兵那么多，也不可能让他们睡街。
掌柜一看到昔小苑他就笑的跟朵花似的，这人肯定是个不得了的人，而且一看就是个大财主官爷。
掌柜笑的一脸开心，而后暗搓搓手的说道：“官爷，需要什么尽管说…”
昔小苑很是大气的说道：“给咱们大伙们弄些好菜好酒上来。”
沐梓丞在旁边双手交叉静静地看着昔小苑装逼。
大伙们已经坐满客栈一大部分的桌子了，昔小苑坐在那里举起手里的小酒杯，看着周围的大伙们说道：
“大伙们今晚我们就吃好点，早点睡~养好精神明天继续赶路，今晚我们的酒就小酌一下，不可多喝，当润润喉可好。”
大伙们士气满满很是配合的说道：“好！谢过丞相。”
昔小苑欣慰一笑地说道：“行了，大伙们都饿了，吃吧，吃饱才有精神。”
看着大伙们潇洒的吃着，但是昔小苑的内心感觉莫名的悲伤难过。

他们虽然是兵，但是都是有家有爸妈的人，都是血肉之躯，带着他们剿匪必定免不了有人受伤什么的……
她要想好对策，最好让他们安然无恙的回来。
剿匪过于凶险，必须想好应有的对策了……
昔小苑跟张文一桌子，张文本来跟他们一起坐的，说她身份高贵，但是被昔小苑拦下了。
难道让她一人吃一大桌？？吃不完不就浪费了吗。
然后沐梓丞坐在旁边看着昔小苑吃，他前面也没有他的碗筷，反正他也就只能看着。
昔小苑看着沐梓丞这囧样就想笑，他只能看不能吃，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…
沐梓丞也不恼，反正他吃不吃都无所谓，他都没有实体，都不会饿。而且他发现，只要他想，他就能碰到那物体，不想的话…直接穿墙都行，不过就是时灵时不灵。
沐梓丞看昔小苑在那幸灾乐祸着，他嘴角一笑，然后默默的走开了。
昔小苑看沐梓丞起身就走了，这丫的要去哪？干嘛去？！她刚刚是不是看见他笑了？还是错觉……
沐梓丞走进厨房，看着忙碌的小二和厨子们。掌柜嘱咐他们说道：“菜一定要做好，可不能出差错，外面都是官爷呀。”
“这些菜赶快端出去，是那桌大官爷的。”
content_en:
Xi Xiaoyuan asked Zhang Wen: "How long does it take to get to Mucheng?"
Zhang Wen said: "It will take about two or three days to arrive."
Xi Xiaoyuan said a little distressed: "It's so far..."
No, it only takes two or three days... In her world, you can get there very quickly by flying, and even trains, subways, etc. are so fast.
Zhang Wen saw that Xi Xiaoyuan was so troubled and said: "Prime Minister... this is fast, and we take a shortcut, two or three days is already fast."
Xi Xiaoyuan nodded and said with a bitter look, "Okay."
Time is passing slowly. When night came, Xi Xiaoyuan drew up the curtains and saw that the sky was getting dark, so she said to Zhang Wen: "Let's find an inn nearby. Everyone has been traveling all day and it's time to take a rest."
Zhang Wen nodded, then stepped out of the carriage, and soon came back and said: "Prime Minister, we have found an inn, let's go there."
Xi Xiaoyuan: "Okay."
The large army stayed at an inn, and most of the rooms in the inn were booked by them. Anyway, the money came from Mu He's pocket...
So we are not afraid. We have money and there are so many soldiers, so we cannot let them sleep on the street.
When the shopkeeper saw Xi Xiaoyuan, he smiled like a flower. This man must be a great person, and he looked like a wealthy official.
The shopkeeper smiled happily, then rubbed his hands secretly and said, "Master, if you need anything, just ask..."
Xi Xiaoyuan said very grandly: "Bring us some good food and wine."
Mu Zicheng stood beside him with his hands folded and watched Xi Xiaoyuan pretending to be cool.
Everyone had already filled most of the tables in the inn. Xi Xiaoyuan sat there and raised the small wine glass in his hand, looked at the people around him and said:
"Everyone, let's eat well tonight and go to bed early. Keep your spirits up and continue the journey tomorrow. We'll just have a sip of the wine tonight. Don't drink too much. Just use it to moisten your throat."
Everyone was full of morale and said cooperatively: "Okay! Thank you, Prime Minister."
Xi Xiaoyuan smiled happily and said: "Okay, everyone is hungry, let's eat. Only when you are full can you feel energetic."
Seeing everyone eating happily, Xi Xiaoyuan felt inexplicably sad in her heart.
Although they are soldiers, they are all people with families and parents, and they are all flesh and blood. When you lead them to suppress bandits, some people will inevitably be injured...
If she had to think of a countermeasure, it would be best for them to come back safe and sound.
Suppressing bandits is too dangerous, we must think of appropriate countermeasures...
Xi Xiaoyuan and Zhang Wen shared a table. Zhang Wen came to sit with them, saying that she had a noble status, but was stopped by Xi Xiaoyuan.
Should she be allowed to eat a large table by herself? ? Wouldn’t it be a waste if you can’t finish it?
Then Mu Zicheng sat aside and watched Xi Xiaoyuan eat. There was no bowl or chopsticks in front of him, so he could only watch anyway.
Xi Xiaoyuan wanted to laugh when he saw Mu Zicheng's embarrassment. He could only watch but not eat, hahahahahahahahaha...
Mu Zicheng is not annoyed. It doesn't matter whether he eats or not. He has no body and will not be hungry. And he discovered that as long as he wanted to, he could touch the object. If he didn't want to... he could just go through the wall, but it would only work sometimes.
Mu Zicheng saw Xi Xiaoyuan gloating over her misfortune. He smiled and walked away silently.
Xi Xiaoyuan saw Mu Zicheng get up and leave, where is this girl going? Why go? ! Did she just see him smile? Or an illusion...
Mu Zicheng walked into the kitchen and looked at the busy waiter and cooks. The shopkeeper told them: "The dishes must be cooked well, but no mistakes can be made. There are officials outside."
"Bring these dishes out quickly, they belong to the high official at that table."
